summary.en: Product video: problem, benefit, proof, next step - factual, without pressure.
summary.de: Produktvideo: Problem, Nutzen, Beleg, nächster Schritt - sachlich, ohne Druck.

audience: Prospective users who do not know the product yet
tone: Confident, friendly and concrete; benefits before features; never exaggerated

structure.purpose: Name the product and the one promise in a short hook
The situation the viewer recognises, in their words
The one benefit that answers it, shown not listed
A concrete use: who, what, result
Proof: a real number, quote or feature that can be checked
Next step: one clear, voluntary action

rules: Name only claims the task or its sources support.
Close with exactly one call to action, phrased as an invitation.
avoid: Superlatives (best, number one) without a source.
Pressure, scarcity, fear or comparisons that disparage others without proof.
